correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the complete domain (12 triples cover each of 36 unordered pairs once), six-cycle switch operation, and exact reduction to a transposition on nine point labels. Two alternating perfect matchings on the six points away from an (a,b)-block form one alternating six-cycle. Affine STS(9) has stabilizer AGL(2,3) of order 432; the minimum transposition length in a permutation coset is min_{h in H}(9-cycles(pi*h)). The supplied exact-cover and affine-coset scripts were read, and a NEW independent exact-cover plus transposition-orbit construction generated 840 labeled systems and traversed all 840 BFS roots, confirming EVERY c-distance class: (12,0):1, (6,1):36, (4,2):27, (3,2):152, (2,2):216, (1,3):216, (0,3):192 per root. Unordered distance counts 15120,165900,171360; sum C(840,2). This is exhaustive for labeled order nine, not evidence for other orders.
risks: The finite exhaustive proof assumes the explicit switching definition with labels fixed; changing switch moves or quotienting by isomorphism changes the metric.

evidence: all 705600 ordered pairs checked by independent all-roots breadth-first traversal
value.rationale: The STS(9) six-cycle switch graph is a canonical labeled trade graph with an established connectivity problem. Its complete shortest-path metric and sharp diameter 3 quantify exact reconfiguration cost; the c-to-distance classification and antipodal layers are not a trivial consequence of the 840 states or connectivity. An exact small finite result with a complete natural metric is independently useful as a benchmark for switching algorithms, without pretending to generalize to arbitrary STS orders.
risks: Finite-order specialization only; all-orders switch-distance bounds remain open.

final_claim: For any ordered pair of labeled STS(9), six-cycle-switch distance depends only on common block count c: 0 for c=12, 1 for c=6, 2 for c in {2,3,4}, and 3 for c in {0,1}. The 840-vertex graph has degree 36, radius and diameter 3 and layers 1,36,395,408.
limitations: Only STS on nine labeled points, only the specified six-cycle trade, not the improper-system Markov-chain move.
The finite exhaustive proof assumes the explicit switching definition with labels fixed; changing switch moves or quotienting by isomorphism changes the metric.
